title: Iron Legion movement rules (content/rules/movement.json5)
description: Engine tunables read by the movement, pathfinding, steering and collision systems (Simulation Spec 5 and 15.1). One merged object per enabled mod set; every field is required in the flagship game because the engine carries no numeric defaults.

nav_cell.description: Nav grid cell size in metres (SIM-MOVE-001).

hpa_cluster.description: HPA* cluster edge in nav cells (SIM-MOVE-003, Phase 3).

hpa_gate_split.description: Gate runs longer than this get end nodes too (SIM-MOVE-003).

wheel_rate.description: Anchor turn rate in degrees per second (SIM-MOVE-010, SIM-FORM-024).

waypoint_radius.description: Metres within which a waypoint counts as reached (SIM-MOVE-010).

slot_arrive_radius.description: Metres to the slot below which a soldier is Idle (SIM-CORE-011).

slot_leave_radius.description: Metres from the slot above which a soldier moves again (SIM-CORE-011).

sep_margin.description: Extra metres beyond touching radii at which separation starts (SIM-MOVE-022).

arrive_damping.description: Fraction of the remaining distance per tick a soldier may close when arriving (SIM-MOVE-021).

lookahead_ticks.description: Ticks of travel probed for impassable cells (SIM-MOVE-023).

soldier_turn_rate.description: Soldier facing turn rate in degrees per second (SIM-MOVE-024).

straggler_radius.description: In file spacings (sf): a soldier farther than this from its slot is a straggler (SIM-MOVE-012).

straggler_fraction.description: Straggler fraction above which the anchor slows (SIM-MOVE-012).

straggler_slowdown.description: Anchor speed multiplier while waiting for stragglers (SIM-MOVE-012).

slope_penalty.description: Speed loss per unit uphill gradient (SIM-MOVE-030).

slope_bonus.description: Speed gain per unit downhill gradient (SIM-MOVE-030).

slope_min_mult.description: Lower clamp of the slope multiplier (SIM-MOVE-030).

slope_max_mult.description: Upper clamp of the slope multiplier (SIM-MOVE-030).

paths_per_tick.description: Path requests served per tick, ascending regiment id (SIM-MOVE-005).

ford_defence_mult.description: Defence multiplier while standing in a ford (SIM-MOVE-032).

spatial_cell.description: Soldier spatial grid cell size in metres (TDD 5).

anchor_cell.description: Regiment anchor grid cell size in metres (TDD 5).

zone_cell.description: Terrain zone raster cell size in metres (TDD 6.2).
